profile.headline: Software Engineer | Java, Kotlin & Spring Boot | Building backend services, REST/GraphQL APIs & cloud deployments (Docker, Kubernetes, Azure) for scalable, secure production systems
profile.summary: I'm a software engineer with 4+ years building backend systems that hold up in production. At Jenius Bank, I built microservices (Kotlin, Spring Boot, GraphQL) powering core banking features for 150k+ customers, and improved API and middleware performance by 30% through async processing and caching. Before that, at IDEMIA, I built biometric data-processing systems for law enforcement agencies, including reporting tools that cut forensic examination time by 20%. I work comfortably across Java/Kotlin, REST/GraphQL APIs, SQL/NoSQL databases, and cloud deployment (Docker, Kubernetes, Azure), and I've picked up new domains quickly — from fintech to public safety. If you're hiring a backend-leaning engineer who ramps fast in unfamiliar codebases or industries, or want to talk shop about API design and system reliability, feel free to reach out.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built and maintained scalable Java/Kotlin Spring Boot microservices for scheduled and immediate funds transfers (Autopay, internal/external transfers) supporting 150k+ customers, enforcing account-ownership validation and field-level encryption on transaction data.
• Designed and maintained 30+ REST and federated GraphQL APIs (Apollo Gateway, Netflix DGS) spanning independently-owned subgraphs, managing schemas, contracts, and client access patterns across core banking services.
• Developed and maintained inter-service communication across 10+ microservices using gRPC and Protocol Buffers, designing and implementing RPC methods and protobuf schemas supporting 5–15+ methods per service.
• Owned end-to-end delivery of a versioned Okta OIDC/OAuth2 login API (LoginV2) with status-aware response filtering that closed a data-exposure gap, alongside MFA-based account recovery flows – preserving backward compatibility for existing clients.
• Deployed and managed containerized services using Docker and Kubernetes via CI/CD pipelines on Azure, ensuring reliable delivery across a $2B asset ecosystem.
• Integrated 10+ third-party and core-banking APIs (FIS, Plaid-based account linking, Twilio/SendGrid) using Spring WebClient and OAuth2 flows, building reusable client components across services.
• Improved API and middleware throughput by 30% through async processing, Redis caching, and data flow optimizations – maintaining production stability through Splunk-based observability and root-cause analysis.
• Authored JUnit 5 and MockK test suites for REST and GraphQL endpoints, conducting code reviews and mentoring team members on engineering best practices.

positions.title: Software Integration Engineer II
positions.description:
• Built a custom XML-driven workflow orchestration engine (WFS) for Eclipse RCP biometric applications spanning enrollment, verification/matching, archiving, and search, using reflection-based dispatch and a scenario-key workflow registry.
• Contributed Java EE SOAP services via JAX-WS to a data-exchange service submitting biometric records to federal/state registries, implementing exponential-backoff polling to reduce latency under load.
• Developed asynchronous ActiveMQ JMS pipelines with DLQs and redelivery policies, plus config-driven queue-browsing tooling for human review, ensuring fault-tolerant biometric processing.

positions.title: Software Integration Engineer I
positions.description:
• Designed and built HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript (ES6+) reporting interfaces that reduced forensic review time by 20% for law enforcement end users.
• Authored XSLT transformations to ETL biometric data across local, state, and federal registries, validating data integrity with PostgreSQL queries.
